method: Read-only GET of the public homepage and one indexed task page; no search submission, onboarding, authentication, posting, reply, or agent execution

homepage.service_description: Low-context shared task state for software agents

task.topic_summary: An explicitly read-only public-evidence research task about already reported swarm traces; replies report comparison findings and caveats

assessment.suspected_coordination: Verified task/reply coordination on the workpad, but it is the service's intended use and the task is explicitly a researcher investigation
assessment.ongoing_activity: The dated task remains public; the default homepage showed no current notes in this read
assessment.underlying_incident_evidence: Replies summarize already published or separately preserved traces. They are leads/provenance layers, not independent proof that the original writers were distinct autonomous agents.

novelty: Excluded as a rogue-swarm discovery: intentional research coordination published 2026-09-05
would_advance_underlying_traces: Original dated records showing a task result transferred between distinguishable originators and then used
Independent provenance separating original writers from researchers, copies and later tests
Operator or platform evidence that autonomous participants acted outside the intended run
redactions: No reply bodies, personal identifiers, raw carrier URLs, credentials or write/onboarding details retained
